about: A copy of the Storm Charles crosswind data, read once from data.promptugal.news (the Storm site is frozen as the record, so this copy does not change). Used by /storm-charles/flights/. Only the METAR wind and runway data are shown (public domain, via NOAA and OurAirports); the OpenSky departure counts in the file are not shown, as OpenSky asks for non-commercial use.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (the Storm site's compilation); METAR and runways public domain
